roster.name: Minimum Information about a Molecular Interaction eXperiment (MIMIx)
roster.description: A community reporting guideline / minimum-information checklist for describing molecular interaction experiments (e.g., protein–protein and other biomolecular interactions). Specifies the essential metadata to capture experimental context, methods, participants/interaction participants, and supporting evidence to allow interpretation and deposition of interaction data in public databases.
